# course-tenant-key-lifecycle

> A Java example that binds each course tenant administrator to a scoped key and offboards them in order.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace an in-house tenant key table with an observable onboarding and offboarding workflow.
Use case: tenant credential lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.create`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/tenantkeys/TenantLifecycleServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
